meta.name: Particle Burst
meta.description: Sparks explode from the center on every beat and coast outward as closed-form trajectories of (index, age). Directions and speeds re-roll each burst; particles fade as they fly. Additive blend for a fireworks glow.
meta.author: ViewMusic built-in

element.x: rand(i + beat_count * 1000) * 0.04 - 0.02 + cos(rand(i + beat_count * 1000) * tau) * settings.spread * (0.4 + 0.6 * rand(i + 100 + beat_count * 1000)) * clamp((t - lastBeatT) / settings.life, 0, 1)
element.y: sin(rand(i + beat_count * 1000) * tau) * settings.spread * (0.4 + 0.6 * rand(i + 100 + beat_count * 1000)) * clamp((t - lastBeatT) / settings.life, 0, 1) - settings.gravity * 0.6 * pow(clamp((t - lastBeatT) / settings.life, 0, 1), 2)

color.a: (1 - clamp((t - lastBeatT) / settings.life, 0, 1)) * step(0, settings.life - (t - lastBeatT))
